reason: Prioritize the role-specific merge first: separate SME helpers each carry streaming entry/exit boundaries, and merging them may remove one boundary per call, but its cost is not isolated and code-generation risk needs checking. The other early experiments target the repeated hot loop or output path without adding packing. Schedule interleaving, store simplification, tile traversal, and padded scratch are plausible tests, not established gains; baseline scores vary widely. The indirect-store proposals are duplicate variants, so they should not all consume separate experiments. Packing proposals also overlap heavily and add timed work; the combined A/B panels equal the reported 128 KiB L1D capacity. The rejected paired-load-only change is excluded. No ranking implies a measured gain or causal attribution.
